about_the_game:
Lead your soldiers to break through the enemy lines and bring critical intelligence back to your homeland!

Gameplay

A classic strategy tactics game where you will lead your soldiers through a series of strategic battles, engaging in life-or-death struggles with the enemy.

Game Features

■ Skill System: Each class and character has unique skills, greatly enhancing the depth of the game.

■ Promotion System: Every unit type has two possible promotion paths to choose from.

■ Relic System: Equip specific relics to unlock new hidden classes, offering an unprecedented experience.

■ Enhancement System: A unique system of military achievements and honors that allows you to freely allocate attributes and skill upgrades for each unit.

■ Weather System: A variety of weather conditions that add richness to tactical planning.
